adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, `feed_key` is defined (computes a redis key from the feed URL) but is never referenced anywhere in the diff. The polling implementation (`poll_feed` + `recurrence { hourly }`) always `open`s and `SimpleRSS.parse`s the full feed and iterates `rss.items` each run. While `TopicEmbed.import` will avoid creating duplicates and only revises posts when `content_sha1` changes, the unused `feed_key` is dead/misleading code and suggests an unimplemented change-detection/throttling mechanism for the feed itself.
